# Home Service Platform

## Overview
This platform connects users with professional home service providers (plumbers, electricians, cleaners, HVAC technicians, etc.). 

## Important Pages
- Home: /
- Blog: /blogs (Read tips and industry trends)
- Contact: /contact
- FAQ: /faq

## Admin Details
The platform has a secure admin dashboard located at `/admin` which handles:
- Managing Blogs (Create, Edit, Delete, Publish)
- Managing SEO (Meta tags, scripts, etc.)
- User management

## API & Technology Stack
- Built on Next.js 15 (App Router)
- Database: MySQL
- Authentication: Secure cookies & JWT
- Styling: Tailwind CSS
- Rich Text Editor: CKEditor 5
